name: Hotel Martina
kurzbeschreibung:
**Welcome to Hotel Martina in Telfs**

Nestled in the heart of the **Inntal**, just a stone’s throw from **Innsbruck**, **Hotel Martina** in **Telfs** invites you to experience authentic Tyrolean hospitality in a cozy, family-run atmosphere.

**Relax & Enjoy**
After an active day exploring the stunning **Tirol**, unwind in our comfortable rooms and suites, each thoughtfully designed to blend rustic charm with modern comforts. Savor traditional Tyrolean flavors in our **Gasthaus**—from hearty **Kaiserschmarrn** to savory **Gröstl**—all crafted with local ingredients.

**Adventure Awaits**
Whether you’re skiing the slopes of **Seefeld** or hiking through the breathtaking **Karwendel** mountains, **Telfs** is your perfect base. Our team will help you plan unforgettable experiences, from snowy escapades to serene summer walks along the **Inn** River.

**A Taste of Tirol**
Indulge in our daily breakfast buffet, featuring fresh **Tiroler Speck**, homemade jams, and locally sourced cheeses. In the evening, gather around our fireplace for a glass of **Tiroler Apfelstrudel** or a warm **Glühwein**—the perfect way to end a day of exploration.

**Why Choose Us?**
✔ **Central location** – Just 15 minutes from **Innsbruck Airport**
✔ **Authentic Tyrolean warmth** – A true home away from home
✔ **Year-round activities** – From winter sports to summer hiking

**Book your stay today** and let **Hotel Martina** be your gateway to the magic of **Tirol**!
